verdict.translation3d_patch: NOT_PHYSICALLY_CORRECT (deviation from GT per-pixel motion almost unchanged): not implemented
verdict.single_pixel_observable: surface-normal component (both scenes); one tangential direction where texture/curvature exists (USB ~half of points)
verdict.single_pixel_unobservable: one tangential direction for essentially all points; Blade in-plane slide (true motion energy in recoverable subspace 1.5-7%)
verdict.noise: declared depth noise underestimates the measured same-instant (no-GT) discrepancy 14x (USB) and ~1000x (Blade)
verdict.photometric: raw-RGB rows convert 2-8% gain or +0.02 offset into false static motion (p99 tens of mm on USB); gain normalization removes gain but not offset; depth-only immune
